what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Andorra in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 57 Andorran asylum seekers, and Brazil hosted 84.2% of them.
After Brazil, the largest hosts are Peru.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Andorra, so it does not say why people left.
The main year of displacement in the data is 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2001 at 7 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
